description: AUTHORITATIVE euro foreign-exchange reference rate from the European Central Bank — the official daily EUR spot rate against a target currency (ISO 4217: USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, ...). Use for "current EUR/USD rate", "EURUSD spot", "what is the euro worth in dollars", and for historical FX series. Returns `latest` ({period, value}) for the current rate plus recent labeled observations; pass start_period/end_period (or last_n) for a longer history. This is the published mid-market reference rate, not a dealer or exchange quote, so there is no bid/ask spread.

frequency.description: Observation frequency — D (daily), M (monthly), Q (quarterly), A (annual). Default D.

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations. Defaults to 30 when no start_period is given.

name: ecb_exchange_rate
title: Ecb Exchange Rate
